name: Improved Channel Resistance
body:
Your summoned skeletal creatures are resilient.

Prerequisite(s): Bonecaller, druid level 5th.

Benefit(s): Graveborne creatures summoned using the Bonecaller feat gain an additional channel resistance of +2, giving them a total of +4.
